name: Bishoujo Noriko
source:
A part of "Sexy voice" series.

Noriko Noriko sees a strange dream where she is attacked by Sexdroid. When she consults a psychiatrist about it, he suggests an experimental therapy.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1988.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
“Sexy Voice”系列作品之一。

纪子做了一个怪梦，梦中自己遭到性爱机器人的侵犯。她向精神科医生求助，对方建议她尝试一种实验性疗法。
